reason: B is the better proposal because it specifies one bulk microalloying intervention, quantitative strength targets, bounded service conditions, a matched control, and a novel, falsifiable test program, whereas A ambiguously mixes bulk alloying with surface cladding and largely repeats the cited Y–Hf coating study while extrapolating unsupported mechanical benefits. B remains speculative—Zr-rich coherent precipitates, improved ductility/passivation, and measurable room-temperature creep must all be demonstrated—but these uncertainties are directly testable.
